title: Port the pstack reflect skill as bee-reflect
action: Create skills/bee-reflect/ from pstack reflect: SKILL.md and every reference file listed in read_first under /home/thanhsmind/Projects/refs/ai-skills/cursor-plugins/pstack, in bee terms. Each learning routes through bee mailbox reflect or bee decisions log, and a framework change goes through the bee chain (rule agents-feedback-changes-framework). Port rules: the pstack text is the base (D1, D5); every pstack tool is swapped for its bee counterpart per D2: subagent spawning becomes bee dispatch prepare (the payload it returns, never a hand-picked model or subagent_type), model-per-role settings become bee team roles, Cursor /loop and Graphite are dropped, bugbot becomes bee-reviewing, how and why become bee-how and bee-why, show-me-your-work becomes bee-show-me-your-work. A step with no bee counterpart is dropped and named in your port notes. Frontmatter follows skills/bee-how/SKILL.md: name, a description under 300 characters that says what it does, when to use it and what it is not for, and metadata with ecosystem bee. No line names Cursor, Graphite, bugbot or poteto-agent. No code comments in any script (a #! line and a license header are the only exceptions). Copy the pstack LICENSE verbatim to the skill's LICENSE.pstack. Add at least three expect briefs and two near briefs for the skill to packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/fixtures/skill-triggers.json, one of them in Vietnamese, in the fixture's existing shape. Run bee dev regen so the rendered trees and the release manifest match, and commit them with the skill. Write docs/history/pstack-playbook-port/port-notes/skill-bee-reflect.md listing each swap and each dropped step. Facts you need, so no lookup is required: an advisor or design runner goes out as `bee dispatch prepare --runtime claude --kind advisor --role <role> --json`; a judge or reviewer as `--kind reviewer`; read-only gathers as `--kind gather`; the blind-lane roles are lane-1, lane-2 and lane-3, and `bee blind check` checks a blind brief; write these spellings into the skill text, never run them. Bee commands you may run in this cell: cargo test, `.bee/bin/bee dev regen`, `.bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check`, `.bee/bin/bee knowledge check`, and `bee herding notify`. Never run `bee dispatch` or any of its `--help`; the worker guard refuses it and the cell stops. A principle or skill that does not exist in skills/ yet keeps its method as a plain sentence and is named in the port notes.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test skill_triggers && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: skills/bee-reflect/SKILL.md exists with a description under 300 characters
the trigger fixture holds at least three expect and two near briefs for bee-reflect
no file under skills/bee-reflect/ names Cursor, Graphite, bugbot or poteto-agent
prohibitions: No hand-picked model or subagent_type in the skill text
